article.description: Tyler Hall and Harald Frey had 19 points apiece and Montana State survived two last-second shots to edge Eastern Washington 91-90 on Saturday for its fifth straight win.
article.headline: Hall, Frey help Montana State edge EWU 91-90 in OT
article.linkText: Hall, Frey help Montana State edge EWU 91-90 in OT
article.story: BOZEMAN, Mont. -- Tyler Hall and Harald Frey had 19 points apiece and Montana State survived two last-second shots to edge Eastern Washington 91-90 on Saturday for its fifth straight win. Devonte Klines made 1 of 2 free throws for the Bobcats with 28 seconds left and the Eagles had two chances to win. Felix Von Hofe missed a jumper with two seconds left but the rebound went off Montana State and Ty Gibson's catch-and-shoot 3-pointer was off the mark. Eastern Washington's Sir Washington hit a 3-pointer with seven seconds left in regulation and another at the buzzer, after Klines made 1 of 2 free throws, to force the overtime. Quinton Everett added 15 points for the Bobcats (11-10, 6-4 Big Sky), who made 14 of 17 free throws, including 7 of 8 in OT to go with a 3-pointer from Hall, and had just four turnovers. Jacob Wiley had 34 points on 14-of-18 shooting and nine rebounds for the Eagles (14-8, 6-3), who had won three straight. Washington and Bogdon Bliznyuk had 13 each.
